title: Fix SSE message buffer unbounded memory growth
description: weaver-server/src/transport/sse-adapter.ts:L67,L99 — Every message sent to an SSE client is pushed to messages[] which is never trimmed. Long-lived connections accumulate all messages in memory, leading to OOM under sustained load. Fix: implement a ring buffer with max capacity, or stop retaining messages after initial snapshot delivery.
close_reason: Implemented ring buffer with configurable max capacity (default 1000). Oldest messages evicted via shift(). Test added.

title: Fix schema-registry typeof logic bug
description: schema-registry.ts:95 uses typeof obj[prop] which returns JS type strings (string/number/undefined), not JSON schema types. Should read the type property from the schema object instead.
close_reason: Fixed in pass 3

title: Fix MongoDB disposed flag correctness bug
description: onExternalChange sets this.disposed=true on the entire provider instance. If a consumer calls onExternalChange twice and unsubscribes once, the second stream is killed. Use a per-subscription disposed boolean instead.
close_reason: Fixed in pass 3

title: config-engine missing zod in package.json dependencies
description: config-engine imports zod directly in index.ts and zod-schema-generator.ts but does not declare it in package.json. Works via hoisting but breaks if published. Add zod ^4.0.0 to dependencies.
close_reason: Added zod ^4.0.0 to config-engine package.json dependencies

title: Wrap git-manager operations in try/catch with typed error results
description: git-manager.ts L51-97: ensureClone(), refresh(), commitAndPush(), revert() — none catch git failures. Network timeouts, auth failures, merge conflicts all propagate as unhandled exceptions. Wrap git ops in try/catch, implement retry for transient errors, return typed error results. CRITICAL: Any git remote issue crashes server or leaves state inconsistent.
close_reason: All git-manager public methods now return GitOperationResult<T> discriminated union with retryable flag. Callers updated.

title: Add error handler on MongoDB changeStream to prevent crash on disconnect
description: mongodb-storage-provider.ts L84-97: changeStream.on('change', ...) is set but no 'error' listener is registered. If MongoDB disconnects, the unhandled error crashes the process. Add changeStream.on('error', ...) handler with reconnection logic. CRITICAL: Production crash on MongoDB connection loss.
close_reason: Added changeStream.on('error') handler that logs and closes stream gracefully. No crash on MongoDB disconnect.

title: Add error boundary around provider.load() in config-service startup
description: config-service.ts L104-107: If any provider's load() throws (MongoDB unreachable, file missing), the entire server startup crashes with an unhandled rejection. Wrap each provider.load() in try/catch, log errors, skip failed providers, mark health as degraded. CRITICAL: Single provider failure = total server failure.
close_reason: Wrapped provider.load() in try/catch with degradedProviders tracking. Failed providers are skipped, server still starts.

title: Fix fire-and-forget writes causing silent data loss
description: config-providers/src/configuration-service.ts:L356-L362 — provider.write(key, value).catch(...) is fire-and-forget. If the write fails (network, disk), in-memory state diverges from persistent state with no reconciliation. User sees successful set() but value is never persisted. Fix: either make set() async and propagate errors, or implement a write-ahead log with retry.
close_reason: Provider writes now awaited with error propagation

title: Add error handling and circuit-breaker to Azure Key Vault provider
description: config-secrets/src/azure-keyvault-provider.ts:L30-L51 — resolve(), store(), delete() propagate raw Azure SDK exceptions with no wrapping, retry, or fallback. No circuit-breaker or timeout. A transient KV outage propagates uncontrolled failures to every config resolution. Fix: add per-call timeout, wrap errors in typed SecretResolutionError, add circuit-breaker state.
close_reason: Added try/catch, timeout, circuit-breaker (threshold/cooldown/half-open) to Azure Key Vault provider. Created SecretResolutionError typed class.

title: Use Promise.allSettled in secret resolution resolveAll
description: config-secrets/src/secret-resolution-service.ts:L73-L78 — resolveAll uses Promise.all, meaning one failing secret reference causes the entire resolution to reject. A single missing/expired secret prevents all secrets from resolving. Fix: use Promise.allSettled, return resolved values for successes and surface errors for failures with partial-failure semantics.
close_reason: resolveAll now uses Promise.allSettled with partial-failure semantics. Returns SecretResolutionResult with resolved Map + failures array.

title: Fix Zod v4 schema re-export without declared dependency in weaver-client
description: weaver-client/src/types.ts:L3-L6 re-exports runtime Zod v4 schema objects (configDeltaSchema, configSnapshotSchema) from @weaver/config-types but does not declare zod as a dependency. Works via workspace hoisting accident. Fix: either add zod ^4.0.0 to weaver-client deps, or stop re-exporting runtime schemas (export type-only inferred types instead).
close_reason: Changed to type-only re-exports, removed runtime Zod dependency

title: Fix README Quick Start to match actual API signatures

title: Batch Git writes, abstract provider lifecycle, replace console logging
description: Three related cleanups: (1) GitStorageProvider currently commits+pushes on every write() call. Refactor to batch: write()/remove() are local-only FSP mutations; new flush() method does git add/commit/push atomically. GitManager gains commitAndPush() with internal mutex for serialization. GitWriteQueue removed entirely. (2) change-detector.ts imports GitManager directly (storage-specific type in core). Add refresh?() and flush?() to ConfigurationStorageProvider interface. Change detector uses provider.refresh(), configService gets flush() that delegates to providers. (3) console.warn/error used directly in config-service, audit-service, shutdown. Add minimal WeaverLogger interface, inject into services.
close_reason: Complete: (1) GitStorageProvider batches writes — write()/remove() are local-only, flush() does one commit+push. GitWriteQueue deleted entirely. GitManager owns serialization via mutex. (2) change-detector no longer imports GitManager — uses configService.refreshProviders(). Zero storage-specific imports in src/core/. (3) console.warn/error replaced with injected WeaverLogger in config-service, audit-service, shutdown. All 805 tests pass.

title: Push gitWriteQueue down into GitStorageProvider
description: gitWriteQueue is currently injected into 4 core services (promotion-engine, scope-manager, rollback-service, schema-registry) that all wrap configService.set() calls in enqueue(). This leaks a Git-specific serialization concern into storage-agnostic business logic. The queue should live inside GitStorageProvider.write()/remove() where the serialization is actually needed. MongoDB and in-memory providers don't need it. Fix: inject shared gitWriteQueue into GitStorageProvider at construction, make write()/remove() auto-serialize, remove gitWriteQueue from all 4 core service option interfaces. Schema registry's queue usage is especially wrong — it wraps in-memory Map.set() in the queue.
close_reason: Removed gitWriteQueue from all 4 core services (promotion-engine, scope-manager, rollback-service, schema-registry). Queue correctly lives in GitStorageProvider.write()/remove() only. Zero references to GitWriteQueue in src/core/. 204 server tests pass.
